charts.name: About
charts.text:
## Calendar Sync — Health & Activity

One-way sync **Google Calendar → monday.com board**, hosted on monday code.  Audience: oncall + product health.

- **Default range:** 7d · **Refresh:** 5m
- **Filter** by config / user / tag / level using the bar below.
- **Oncall:** start with the 4 stats → if red, check *Sync errors by tag* → drill into *Recent errors* (bottom).
- **Cron / OAuth panels** can be sparse — they fire <10×/day; keep the 7d range when looking at them.

Docs: see `CLAUDE.md` in the repo for architecture + endpoint contracts.

apl.apl: ['calendar-sync'] | where isnotempty(acc) | distinct acc | project key=acc, value=acc | sort by key asc
['calendar-sync'] | where isnotempty(obj) | distinct obj | project key=obj, value=obj | sort by key asc
['calendar-sync'] | where isnotempty(cfg) | distinct cfg | project key=cfg, value=cfg | sort by key asc
['calendar-sync'] | where isnotempty(usr) | distinct usr | project key=usr, value=usr | sort by key asc

declare query_parameters (acc_filter:string="", obj_filter:string="", cfg_filter:string="", usr_filter:string="", tag_filter:string="", level_filter:string="");
['calendar-sync']
| where (isempty(acc_filter) or acc == acc_filter)
| where (isempty(obj_filter) or obj == obj_filter)
| where (isempty(cfg_filter) or cfg == cfg_filter)
| where (isempty(usr_filter) or usr == usr_filter)
| where (isempty(tag_filter) or tag == tag_filter)
| where (isempty(level_filter) or level == level_filter)
| where tag == "sync" and message == "sync_done"
| summarize ['Sync runs'] = count()

charts.name: Per-config usage (created / updated / deleted / skipped / errors)

query.apl:
declare query_parameters (acc_filter:string="", obj_filter:string="", cfg_filter:string="", usr_filter:string="", tag_filter:string="", level_filter:string="");
['calendar-sync']
| where (isempty(acc_filter) or acc == acc_filter)
| where (isempty(obj_filter) or obj == obj_filter)
| where (isempty(cfg_filter) or cfg == cfg_filter)
| where (isempty(usr_filter) or usr == usr_filter)
| where (isempty(tag_filter) or tag == tag_filter)
| where (isempty(level_filter) or level == level_filter)
| where isnotempty(cfg)
| summarize
    runs = countif(tag == "sync" and message == "sync_done"),
    created = sum(created),
    updated = sum(updated),
    deleted = sum(deleted),
    skipped = sum(skipped),
    errors = countif(level == "error" or message == "error"),
    instance = take_any(obj),
    user = take_any(usr),
    last_seen = max(_time)
  by cfg
| order by runs desc
| take 50
| project Config = cfg, Instance = instance, User = user, Runs = runs, Created = created, Updated = updated, Deleted = deleted, Skipped = skipped, Errors = errors, ['Last seen'] = last_seen

charts.text:
### Monitors

No monitors created yet for `calendar-sync`.

Create them in **Axiom → Monitors**, then swap this panel to a `MonitorList` chart with the chosen monitor IDs.

**Suggested monitors:**
- Sync error-rate >5% over 1h
- Hours since last cron tick >25
- Disconnected configs > 0 (sustained)
- Webhook hits drop to 0 over 30m
